designationHistory.indexText: Grays Lake National Wildlife Refuge was established through a cooperative agreement with the Bureau of Indian Affairs and local landowners.

authority.citation: Refuge use cooperative agreement among the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Bureau of Indian Affairs and local landowners

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established. Held for human review: touches Indigenous history (agreement with the Bureau of Indian Affairs).
